purpose: Prove Approved Instruction promotion and supersession locally: one memory candidate is promoted to an active Approved Instruction (CAI-LOCAL-001) via a human/Doug approval receipt carrying authority basis, rationale, and source evidence; then a replacement instruction (CAI-LOCAL-002) is approved via a NEW receipt, and the prior instruction is marked superseded with a link to the new instruction plus a dedicated supersession receipt. The prior instruction text and its original approval receipt stay byte-identical (priorInstructionUnchanged=true); supersession never overwrites. Receipts here are local contract evidence only, and every live mutation stays receipt-gated to Epic 2.
